key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:INSTALL:0:02EA
name: run_delete_command_strings
description: Makes five calls to unnamed routines that issue the installer's delete command lines through a library entry at a fixed offset of 222.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:INSTALL:0:031E
name: read_alphanumeric_line_into_buffer
description: Reads characters through input library calls, echoing and storing alphanumeric input in a buffer up to a given count, handling backspace and stopping at return; with its flag set it accepts only yes or no answers.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:INSTALL:0:03EA
name: create_hd_info_file
description: Copies a name into a buffer, appends six more characters, and opens, writes and closes a file through dos library calls; the referenced text includes the .info suffix and the names 'CYBERDREAMS' and 'hdfile'.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:INSTALL:0:0E8A
name: retry_two_calls_four_times
description: Retries a pair of unnamed calls up to four times, returning the attempt index when the second call returns zero, or minus one when all four attempts fail.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:INSTALL:0:0EDE
name: open_device_unit_retry_mark
description: Opens a device unit through a library entry; on failure it marks the unit as failed and returns minus one, and on success it waits through a 900-pass loop for a status word if the unit was marked before clearing the mark.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:INSTALL:0:0EE2
name: open_trackdisk_device_and_io
description: Creates a message port, opens trackdisk.device for a unit through exec, sends an I/O request, and removes the port, marking the unit as failed and returning minus one on error.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:INSTALL:0:0FA8
name: verify_unit_record_matches_stored
description: Calls two library entries for a unit, then compares a stored 32-bit value and a 16-bit value against a 12-byte unit record, returning zero when both match and minus one otherwise.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:INSTALL:0:0FC8
name: verify_unit_record_twin_check
description: Performs the same unit-record check as its twin routine, returning zero when the stored values match and minus one otherwise.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:INSTALL:0:1008
name: verify_unit_record_alias
description: Performs the same unit-record comparison as its neighbouring routines, returning zero on a match and minus one otherwise.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:INSTALL:0:1018
name: verify_unit_record_duplicate
description: Repeats the unit-record comparison found in its neighbours, returning zero on a match and minus one otherwise.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:INSTALL:0:1024
name: verify_drive_record_lock_examine
description: Runs the same unit-record comparison as its neighbours; the referenced text names the drives darkseed_1: and df0:, and the routine reaches dos lock, examine and unlock entries.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:0000
name: start_program_init_table
description: Program entry that checks for a command-line process, waits for a Workbench message when launched from the desktop, copies a block of constant longwords into a global table, then makes three calls.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:0040
name: open_three_libraries_or_close
description: Opens the dos, graphics and intuition libraries in turn through exec, closing any already opened library when a later one fails.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:00A6
name: return_immediately
description: Does nothing and returns.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:00C6
name: shut_down_interrupts_and_libraries
description: Releases system resources: when a flag word is set it makes one call and then two library calls at a fixed negative offset of 48; the wider code also removes an interrupt server, frees memory and closes libraries, and references the text 'DSSG'.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:0362
name: find_record_set_status_flag
description: Scans a table of 16-byte records for an entry whose two key bytes match the arguments; on a match it sets bit one in the record's status byte and marks a global flag, and it returns when a sentinel record is reached.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:036A
name: set_matched_record_status_flag
description: Sets bit one in the status byte of the matched record, sets a global flag, and makes one or two unnamed calls, with an extra call when the record's first character is J.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:03C4
name: store_byte_into_record_fields
description: Makes one unnamed call, then stores the byte argument in three record fields at offsets 54, nine and ten.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:0824
name: select_frame_buffer_by_parity
description: Toggles a parity flag, chooses one of two buffer addresses from it, and adds 44 to that address when the top bit of the vertical position register is set.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:0870
name: pass_through_value_after_call
description: Makes one call to an unnamed routine and returns the data register value unchanged.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:087C
name: update_frame_state_and_timer
description: Advances a frame counter when the low bit of a state byte is set and a timer exceeds 179, resets the timer, then compares a value against a stored one and makes sixteen calls, storing two words into fixed locations on one path.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:0A9C
name: propagate_status_bit_between_records
description: If bit zero of one record's status byte is set, sets bit zero of a second record's status byte.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:0ADC
name: toggle_indexed_status_bits
description: Toggles bit sixteen in a table entry chosen by the D1 argument, and when a stored code equals ten also toggles bit zero of the record's status byte.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:0B84
name: return_immediately_again
description: Does nothing and returns.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:0BBE
name: split_count_by_3600
description: Returns zero for counts below 68400; otherwise it divides the count by 3600, offsets the quotient by minus 18, and returns that together with the remainder.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:0C44
name: lookup_scaled_table_byte
description: Adds a byte argument to a byte from a global array, multiplies the sum by nine, and returns the table byte at that index.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:0C78
name: copy_header_record_and_arm
description: Copies a six-byte header from the source record into fixed storage, then sets a global to 161 and then to one.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:0CC2
name: set_indexed_status_bits
description: Sets bit value 116 in one status word and bit value 212 in an entry chosen by the D0 argument, then conditionally calls routines based on a timer and a mode byte.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:0CC8
name: set_indexed_status_notify
description: Sets bit value 212 in a status word selected by the D0 argument, then makes up to four calls depending on a timer and a mode byte.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:0CCE
name: notify_on_timer_and_mode
description: When a timer exceeds 64799 it makes three calls for mode value 64 and one call for mode value 11.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:0D02
name: clear_status_bit_after_call
description: Makes one call, then clears bit zero of the status byte of the record addressed by the argument register.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:0D12
name: set_status_bit_after_call
description: Makes one call, then sets bit zero of the status byte of the record addressed by the argument register.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:0D22
name: toggle_status_bit_after_call
description: Makes one call, then toggles bit zero of the status byte of the record addressed by the argument register.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:0D3E
name: update_sprite_movement_and_collision
description: Moves an entity by stepping its position and checks a one-bit-per-pixel map at the stepped location, updating status bits and making calls; the full logic is longer than this excerpt.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:0FD6
name: return_without_action
description: Returns without doing anything; the decompiled body is an immediate return, so its real effect cannot be recovered from this view.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:10C4
name: store_position_and_scaled_offset
description: Stores two argument words into record fields at offsets 14 and 16, then computes a third field at offset 38 from another record's values, scaled by the second argument minus 275 divided by six.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:1164
name: store_level_with_high_flag
description: Clears the high bit of a status byte, sets it and subtracts four from the level when the level exceeds four, then stores the level plus 24 into three record bytes.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:1190
name: step_line_until_clear_pixel
description: Walks from one point toward another, advancing by per-record step sizes, and continues while the one-bit-per-pixel map at the current point is set, stopping at the target.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:120E
name: compute_manhattan_distances_to_point
description: For each three-word entry in a list, computes the sum of absolute horizontal and vertical differences from a reference point and stores it in the entry, then finds the smallest distance starting from 5000.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:1306
name: walk_line_with_step_sizes
description: Computes absolute horizontal and vertical distances between two points, sets per-axis step sizes from them, then walks toward the target over the one-bit-per-pixel map.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:1352
name: halve_steps_when_slow
description: Sets a flag in the record and, when a speed field is below 741, makes a call and halves both step-size bytes if the speed is below 351.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:136A
name: halve_both_step_sizes
description: Shifts both step-size bytes of a record right by one bit.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:1384
name: search_nearby_clear_pixel_spiral
description: Searches outward from a point in alternating steps over a one-bit-per-pixel map, stopping early when a clear position is found and giving up after sixty steps.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:1430
name: mark_table_entries_as_reserved
description: Replaces every table entry equal to the argument byte with minus two, then makes two calls, shifts one record byte left by two, copies a 16-bit field between records and clears a status bit.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:1458
name: restore_reserved_table_entries
description: Replaces every table entry marked minus two with the argument byte, and when any entry changed makes two calls.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:1486
name: select_layout_and_clear
description: Clears bit sixteen in a series of eight-byte entries, selects one of three coordinate pairs from a selector, and when the selector equals three zeroes forty-two longwords before setting bits in a record.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:1522
name: call_set_record_bits_twelve
description: Makes one call, then sets the bit values four and eight in the byte at offset thirteen of the record.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:1546
name: finish_state_with_mode_two
description: Makes eight unnamed calls, sets bit value four in a record, stores 30 in a timer and 198 and 240 in two words, and sets the global to two.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:15BA
name: lookup_doubled_table_offset
description: Looks up a byte from a global array at the index formed by the D2 byte plus 152, doubles it, and adds the D0 argument.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:15D8
name: dispatch_command_code_handlers
description: Dispatches on a command byte: for the byte 169 it resets a state flag, sets a position field to 800, makes a series of calls, then sets bit sixteen and clears the state; the other command cases are longer than this excerpt.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:1B16
name: toggle_flag_byte_and_notify
description: Makes one call, toggles bit zero of the byte at the address register, then makes a second call passing that address; the routine is long and this view shows only its start.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:2098
name: alternate_frame_codes_29_30
description: Sets a per-record code byte to 29, makes calls, sets it to 30, makes a call, then sets it back to 29 and makes another call.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:20BC
name: call_then_hang_forever
description: Makes one call and then loops forever without returning.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:20CC
name: call_toggle_status_bit
description: Makes one call, then toggles bit zero of the status byte of a record.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:20DE
name: clear_flag_wait_for_zero
description: Clears a global flag, then busy-waits until the D0 argument becomes zero.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:2106
name: reset_record_timers_to_28
description: When the global is neither zero nor four, resets it, clears bit zero of a status byte and makes calls, then clears the high bit of a status byte and sets three record bytes to 28.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:213E
name: show_end_text_and_hang
description: Sets bit zero of a status byte, makes two calls, then loops forever; the referenced text is THE END.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:2230
name: dispatch_code_below_32
description: When the argument byte is below 32 it makes calls, sets several table values to 70, 34, 46 and 18, and copies five longwords from a source table; the rest of the code is longer than this excerpt.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:2282
name: call_twice_then_hang
description: Makes two calls and then loops forever.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:232C
name: copy_position_and_arm_record
description: Clears bit zero of one status byte, sets bit zero of a second, sets a 16-bit field to 1000, copies two position words between the records and makes several calls.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:239A
name: finish_entry_clear_flags
description: Sets a global to one, makes calls, multiplies a pending record's counter byte by five by shifting it left two bits and adding it back, copies a position word into two records, and clears two global flags.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:23C4
name: scale_pending_field_clear_flags
description: Multiplies a pending record's counter byte by five, copies a position word from it into two other records, clears one status bit and clears two global flags.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:23FA
name: find_table_entry_by_key
description: Scans a table of three-byte entries until the end marker, returning when an entry's second byte equals the argument byte.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:2418
name: store_history_entry_and_advance
description: Makes one call, stores the byte minus two in a field, writes the argument into a table at the current index, sets a lag counter to zero for indices below eight or to the index minus six otherwise, and advances the index.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:2446
name: remove_table_entry_by_value
description: Makes one call, then searches a byte table for the argument value; when found it shifts the later entries down one place, decrements the table index, and adjusts a lag counter.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:248C
name: call_then_scale_pending_field
description: Makes one call, then multiplies a pending record's counter byte by five, copies a position word into two records, and clears two global flags.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:2494
name: clear_flag_bits_and_call
description: Clears bit sixteen of a global byte, clears bit zero of a record's status byte, then makes one call.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:24B0
name: arm_two_entries_with_codes
description: Sets a global flag to one, clears bit zero of a status byte, zeroes a byte field, makes calls, and writes the byte values 65 and 66 into the entries those calls return.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:24B4
name: arm_two_entries_twin_copy
description: Repeats the arming sequence of its twin: sets a global flag, clears a status bit, zeroes a byte field, and writes the byte values 65 and 66 into the entries returned by two calls.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:2508
name: load_tagged_block_size_check
description: Calls an unnamed routine to set a mode value, reads a block through a library entry, allocates memory for it, verifies a four-byte tag, and rounds the stored 16-bit size up to a multiple of sixteen; the codes one, two and three report its three failure paths.
